sentences.text: Vikash Jasarasaria & Ors vs Unknown on 30 September, 2024

Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
30.09.2024 rc/ct.no.34 Item No.34 Crr No.3924 of 2024 In the matter of : Vikash Jasarasaria &
Ors.
 .......Petitioners
 Mr. Somopriyo Chowdhury
 Mr. Dipayan Dan ...for the Petitioners
The petitioners seek quashing of proceeding of G.R.Case No. 722 of 2024 pending before the learned
Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bidhannagar.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the father of the petitioner nos. 1 and 2 lodged a complaint against the private opposite party and her husband who is his youngest son, under The Maintenance of Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, 2007 wherein an enquiry was held by the Lake Town Police Station.

entities.text: Maintenance of Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, 2007
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The enquiry revealed that the opposite party and her husband were neglecting and torturing the father and were trying to grab the residential property owned by him.

As a counter blast, the private opposite party lodged FIR against the petitioners and the father of the 1st and 2nd petitioners before Asansol (South) Police Station on April 02, 2024 which was registered as Asansol (South) Police Station Case No. 101 of 2024 under Sections 498A/323/406 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of The Dowry Prohibition Act.

entities.text: Asansol (South) Police Station Case No. 101 of 2024
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The case is still pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bidhannagar, North 24 Parganas.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bidhannagar, North 24 Parganas
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioners obtained bail in the said case on April 23, 2024 following which the present complaint was lodged by the private opposite party on almost identical allegations.
It appears that the matter needs to be heard on merit.
The petitioners are directed to serve copy of the application along with annexure thereto upon the opposite parties and file affidavit of service on the adjourned date.

Let this matter appear under the heading "Contested Application" in the monthly list of December,
2024.
Investigation of the case shall proceed but the report shall not be submitted upon completion of the investigation without the leave of this Court.
No coercive steps be taken against the petitioners in connection with the present matter till December 24, 2024 or until further orders, whichever is earlier.
